name.en-US: The Apparition of St. Michael the Archangel
name.pt-BR: A Aparição de São Miguel Arcanjo

prayerExcerpt.en-US: St. Michael is not only the protector of the Church, but of every faithful soul.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: São Miguel não é apenas o protetor da Igreja, mas de toda alma fiel.

meta.face: St. Michael as on the michael_archangel card and in recurring-figures.md: a radiant youthful angel with a softly OVAL face, a smooth brow, a fine straight nose, large clear blue-grey eyes under lightly arched golden brows, rosy rounded cheeks, a small firm mouth, a gently rounded chin; thick golden curls to the jaw; a gold halo; great white wings; a silver breastplate trimmed in gold over a blue skirt, a billowing red-orange mantle; here grave and gentle, commanding, not fighting. The bishop is clearly different: about sixty, a BROAD, LOW-BROWED face with heavy cheekbones, a short blunt nose, small kind dark eyes, a wide mouth; a white tonsured fringe and a short rounded white-grey beard.
meta.basis: The Pictorial Lives recalls that St. Michael, in a vision, told the bishop of Siponto to build a church in his honour on Monte Gargano; the Gargano legend (Liber de apparitione, Golden Legend) adds the bull that led the herdsmen to the cave. Michael keeps the face and armour of the michael_archangel card; the bishop's face is new.

sources.title: Golden Legend: Saint Michael the Archangel (Caxton, Fordham Medieval Sourcebook)
